paragraphs: Shimon, the brother of Azaryah (son of Avtolas; see his entry), the priest, uncle of R' Elazar ben Azaryah. He was called after his brother because he learned Torah through the support of his brother, who engaged in commerce and maintained him so that he might share the merit of Shimon's study: Sotah, Hayah Notel, 21 end of side a; see Rashi there. He is a tanna at the beginning of Mishnah Zevahim. In Yelammedenu, Kedoshim: was not Shimon greater than Azaryah? But because he put food in Shimon's mouth, the halakhah was called after him; see above, Hillel. His brother too was a great sage and distinguished in the priestly house, ninth from Ezra. Rambam writes that he is mentioned in the Mishnah only in Zevahim 1:2. He is also mentioned in Tohorot, chapter 8, mishnah 7.
